title: LazyPerformance
description: 🚀 Boost your game with essential NeoForge performance mods ⚡
body:
# Hallo!!!
I know there are many modpacks out there that might be better than this one, but these are the mods I personally use for my Minecraft. I got tired of installing them every single time, so I created this modpack for convenience. If you're also a NeoForge user who prefers a lightweight setup without being overwhelmed by tons of mods, this modpack is for you. Viel Spaß!

- **_All mods retain their original licenses and belong to their respective authors._** 
- **_This modpack is a curated collection for convenience. And all the mods used are listed in the changelog._**
